title: CLMS Lake Water Quality (LWQ) NRT Global 300m 10-daily V1 (NetCDF)
description: Provides semi-continuous observations for a large number of medium and large-sized lakes. 10-daily observations are available at 300 m spatial resolution with a temporal extent from 2016 to 2024, derived from Sentinel-3 OLCI.
